description.raw: The Church of Santo Stefano is a 16th-century church located in the Piazza dei Cavalieri in Pisa, Italy. It was built by Cosimo I de' Medici for the Order of the Knights of Santo Stefano, a military order founded to combat piracy in the Mediterranean Sea. The church is designed in the Mannerist style, and its façade is adorned with a large Medici coat of arms. The interior of the church is richly decorated with frescoes, paintings, and sculptures. Among the most notable works of art in the church are a series of frescoes by Giorgio Vasari and a painting of the Madonna and Child by Agnolo Bronzino. The Church of Santo Stefano is a popular tourist destination, and it is well worth a visit for its beautiful architecture and its impressive collection of art.
